title: OKX Invite Code: What It Is and How to Use It

thumbnail.image_prompt: two friends looking at one smartphone together outdoors in a park, warm afternoon light, natural and friendly

scenes.title: OKX invite code
scenes.sub: Same thing as a referral code?

media.image_prompt: two friends sharing one smartphone screen in a park, warm afternoon light

lines.show: An OKX invite code is the code an existing user shares so a new user can link their account at sign-up.
In everyday use, invite code and referral code mean the same thing.
Here's how it works, how to use one, and what about the VIP invite codes you may see online.

scenes.title: Two names, one field
scenes.text: Invite code, referral code: same box.

lines.show: Some pages say invite code, others say referral code.
At sign-up, both go into the same field.
So if a friend sends you an invite code, you don't need to look for a different box.

scenes.title: Why do people share invites?
scenes.text: The program terms reward both sides in some cases.

lines.show: Why do people share invite codes at all?
OKX runs a referral program, and its terms can give inviters and new users something in certain cases.
The details live in the app, and they change over time.
Using one takes four steps.
Get a code from a friend or a creator who uses OKX.
Open sign-up in the official app or on the official website.
Type the code in the invite or referral field.
Then finish your identity verification.

scenes.label: Code per new account
scenes.text: Each sign-up links to one inviter.

lines.show: One thing to remember: a new account links to one inviter, set at registration.

scenes.title: What's a VIP invite code?
scenes.text: Often just a label in a post.

lines.show: You may see posts promising a VIP invite code.
Usually that's just a label someone added to their personal code.
VIP levels and fee tiers follow OKX's own rules, shown on the official fee page.
If someone asks for money or your login in exchange for VIP access, it's not a real offer. Walk away.
Real tiers are explained by OKX itself, on its official pages.
If you're curious about VIP levels, go to the official fee page.
It explains how tiers are set, so you don't have to rely on someone's post.

scenes.title: You get a code too
scenes.text: Find it in the app's invite section.

lines.show: Once your account is active, you'll have your own invite code too.
Look for the invite or referral section in the app menu.

scenes.title: Invite only where it's allowed
scenes.text: OKX isn't available in every country.

lines.show: Before you share your own code, remember that OKX doesn't serve every country.
Only invite people who live where the platform is available.
And a short to-do list for day one.
Turn on two-factor authentication.
Read the rewards page and its terms.
And only use support channels inside the official app.
These small steps protect your account from the very first day.

scenes.title: An invite code to use
scenes.text: Works in the invite or referral field

lines.show: Need an invite code? You can use XOACPQFC.
Type it in the invite or referral field when you sign up.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live
scenes.text: Type the code when you sign up

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, enter invite code XOACPQFC during registration.
Thanks for watching.
